products.name: EarFun Air Pro 4 Adaptive ANC Wireless Earbuds, aptX Lossless, LDAC, Auracast
specs: LDAC, aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, LC3, AAC, SBC (aptX Lossless needs a Snapdragon Sound phone; iPhone gets AAC)
11 h with ANC off, 7.5 h with ANC on (EarFun); about 6 h with LDAC and adaptive ANC together (reviewer-measured)
52 h ANC off, 35 h ANC on
USB-C 2 h, wireless 3.5 h; 10 min gives 2 h
QuietSmart 3.0 adaptive hybrid ANC, up to 50 dB claimed; 6 mics
5.4, two-device multipoint (not while LDAC is on), Auracast after firmware update, Google Fast Pair
In-ear detection, wireless charging case, EarFun Audio app with 10-band EQ, game mode
products.warranty: 18 months on items sold by EarFun's store (proof of purchase required).
products.returns: 30-day money-back on undamaged returns with all accessories and packaging; buyer pays return shipping unless the item is defective. Free US ground shipping, 2 to 8 business days (no AK, HI, PR, PO boxes or APO).
products.summary: The only earbuds under $100 here that carry LDAC and aptX Lossless together, with two-device multipoint, wireless charging, IPX5 and in-ear detection. Digital Trends and SoundGuys both gave it an Editors' Choice badge; SoundGuys measured 8 h 44 min per charge.
products.fit: Android owners who want the widest hi-res codec choice, and anyone who wants multipoint plus a hi-res codec: aptX Adaptive and aptX Lossless keep working with two devices connected, LDAC does not.
caveats: Turning LDAC on disables multipoint; LDAC with adaptive ANC drops battery to about 6 h per charge.
ANC measured 7.5 out of 10 in SoundGuys' lab, below the soundcore Liberty 4 NC (8.4) and Space A40 (8.5).
Single-tap volume can trigger when you adjust the bud; remap or disable it in the app.
EarFun's support forum has repeated threads about one bud (usually the left) going silent or not pairing; forgetting and re-pairing fixed most.
Mic is average in noisy places; call quality is best on Snapdragon Sound phones.

products.name: EarFun Air Pro 4+ Hi-Res Adaptive ANC Wireless Earbuds, hybrid driver, aptX Lossless, LDAC
specs: 10 mm dynamic plus FeatherBA balanced armature (hybrid)
LDAC, aptX Lossless, aptX Adaptive, LC3, AAC, SBC
8 h ANC on, 12 h ANC off (EarFun); RTINGS measured about 4.75 h with ANC on
USB-C or wireless case; 10 min gives 2 h
QuietSmart 3.0 adaptive hybrid ANC, up to 50 dB claimed; 6 mics
In-ear detection, 50 ms game mode, EarFun Audio app EQ
products.warranty: 18 months on items sold by EarFun's store (proof of purchase required).
products.returns: 30-day money-back on undamaged returns with all accessories and packaging; buyer pays return shipping unless the item is defective. Free US ground shipping, 2 to 8 business days.
products.summary: The step-up Air Pro with a balanced-armature tweeter, Bluetooth 6.0 and IP55. Same codec set as the Air Pro 4, but RTINGS measured roughly half the Liberty 4 NC's battery with ANC on.
products.fit: Listeners who want a brighter, dual-driver sound and IP55 dust resistance and rarely go more than 4 to 5 hours between case top-ups.
caveats: RTINGS measured about 4.75 h per charge with ANC on, well under the 8 h claim and about half the soundcore Liberty 4 NC.
RTINGS found the fit can loosen over time and the mic struggles in noisy places.
At $99.99 it sits at the top of the under-$100 bracket; the Air Pro 4 gives the same codecs for less.
LDAC disables multipoint, as on every LDAC earbud here.

specs: 40 mm dynamic with DLC composite diaphragm, response to 40 kHz
Hybrid ANC up to 45 dB claimed, anti-wind mode, 5 mics
80 h ANC off, 55 h ANC on; 800 mAh
Two devices; cannot be on at the same time as LDAC
EarFun Audio app for iOS and Android
products.warranty: 18 months on items sold by EarFun's store (proof of purchase required).
products.returns: 30-day money-back on undamaged returns with all accessories and packaging; buyer pays return shipping unless the item is defective. Free US ground shipping, 2 to 8 business days.
products.summary: Budget over-ears with LDAC, 55 hours of ANC-on battery and 45 dB claimed cancelling. CNN Underscored named it its best budget wireless pick; What Hi-Fi called the ANC as expected at the price.
products.fit: Commuters and desk listeners who want LDAC and days of battery for well under $100 and don't need a light, workout-stable headband.
caveats: Gentle clamping force: reviewers found them unstable during sudden movement or workouts.
268 g is heavier than the Sony WH-CH720N class; ear cups fold in an unusual direction.
Call quality and soundstage drew criticism in several reviews.

notes: QUERY CHOICE: 'best LDAC earbuds under $100' (autocomplete-style phrasing; results today are scarbir's LDAC tag list and affiliate roundups, no measured head-to-head). The Air Pro 4 honestly wins the main segment on codec breadth (only sub-$100 set with LDAC + aptX Lossless/Adaptive), multipoint-with-hi-res, IPX5, wireless charging and in-ear detection, backed by Editors' Choice badges from Digital Trends (Aug 2024, says it beats the Liberty 4 NC) and SoundGuys (8.4/10, Dec 2024). Rival wins stated in the lead and table: Liberty 4 NC (ANC 8.4/10, 9.85 h ANC on) and Space A40 (8.5/10, 8 h) measure stronger on ANC and battery. PAIN POINTS (count of sources): LDAC disables multipoint 4 (Digital Trends, GamingTrend, EarFun 4i reviewer note, Wave Pro spec); LDAC 990 kbps stutter 5 forum threads + SoundGuys Ear (a); one bud dead/not pairing 8 EarFun community threads; touch mis-taps 2 (SoundGuys, TechRadar); iPhone AAC-only 3; mic average in noise 3; LDAC+ANC battery ~6 h 2 (Digital Trends, headphonecheck); 'LDAC gain minimal under $50' 2. SEGMENTS: Snapdragon/multipoint = Air Pro 4; ANC/battery = Liberty 4 NC (Space A40 close, weaker mic); cheapest = CMF Buds 2 Plus $59 (sold out at Nothing US today); design = Nothing Ear (a) $79.
